newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan non-life insurers' shares hit by trade pact.
newsitem.headline: Japan non-life insurers' shares hit by trade pact.

text.p: Shares in Japan's non-life insurers 0#INS.T were dragged down for a second day by the weekend agreement settling the Japan-U.S. insurance dispute, which ignited fears that the sector could face fierce competition, brokers said.
As of 0048 GMT, the insurance sector index was down 65.12 points or 2.79 percent at 2,267.16.
Tokio Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd was down to a new low for the year, falling 50 yen to 1,070 yen, the third-largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
Nissan Fire and Marine Insurance Co Ltd shed 21 yen to 619 yen. Nichido Fire & Marine Insurance Co Ltd fell 25 yen to 625 yen.
